## 🔴 High Relevance (Score 7–10)
*Auto-added to Zotero (threshold ≥6)*

**[SIRT3 preserves mitochondrial DNA integrity to restrain cGAS–STING signaling and autoimmune inflammation](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PPR1369699)** *(from Mitochondrial biology / rheumatology (autoimmunity, fibrosis, nephrology))*  
*Meroño Carolina; Cuesta Yara; Marchant Vanessa; Oliva Aurea; Carrancho Alejandra* —  2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `cGAS-STING, mito-ROS-NF-kB, POLG-mtDNA, treatment-target, ME-CFS, clinical-phenotype, other`  
> Shows that mtROS-driven mtDNA leakage activates cGAS-STING and an IFN-β/ISG response in macrophages, with attenuation by MitoTEMPO and reduced SIRT3 in lupus nephritis and RA. This closely parallels the Loop A (mtDNA to cGAS-STING to IFN-I) and mitochondrial ROS arms of the SAMHD1 A565T interferon-mitochondrial model, but it does not involve SAMHD1, dNTP pools, VDAC1, NLRP3 or ISG15-mitophagy, so it is a mechanistically adjacent paper rather than direct evidence.  
DOI: 10.64898/2026.11.15.766791

**[Vanadium Oxide Nanoregulator Modulates cGAS-STING Pathway-Associated Immune Dysregulation in Sepsis.](https://europepmc.org/article/MED/43036058)** *(from Critical care/sepsis and nanomedicine)*  
*Zhou Tian; Jiang Ruoyu; Cao Keyun; Zhu Chenglong; Yang Fengyan* —  2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `cGAS-STING, VDAC1, POLG-mtDNA, mito-ROS-NF-kB, treatment-target, other`  
> The paper shows that blocking mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening and scavenging ROS with vanadium oxide nanospheres limits mtDNA escape and cGAS-STING signaling, which parallels the BLUE stream (VDAC1 macropore, cytosolic mtDNA, cGAS-STING-IFN-I) and the mitochondrial ROS arm of this disease model. It is a sepsis study in mice with no SAMHD1, dNTP, or chronic interferonopathy data, so it offers a mechanistic and therapeutic-concept link rather than direct disease evidence.  
DOI: 10.1002/advs.78756

**[STING activation mediated by DRP1-dependent mitochondrial fission drives manganese-induced neurotoxicity.](https://europepmc.org/article/MED/43038619)** *(from Environmental toxicology / neurotoxicology (Parkinsonian manganism, microglial neuroinflammation))*

**[SAMHD1 functions as a repressor of LINE-1 retrotransposons in human germ cell development.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43036172/)** *(from Reproductive biology / andrology (germ cell development and retrotransposon biology))*  
*Li Zi-Li; Liu Xin-Yu; Tang Ying; Wang Li-Ling; Xu Jia* — Asian journal of andrology 2026  
Score: **6/10** | Pathways: `dNTPase, mTOR-lysosomal, other`  
> The paper shows SAMHD1 restricting LINE-1 retrotransposition through autophagy and eIF2α phosphorylation in human germ cell development, and d4t (a reverse transcription inhibitor) blocks the retrotransposition caused by SAMHD1 loss. This is mechanistic SAMHD1 data (the atlas lists LINE-1 restriction as a function partly lost in A565T heterozygotes), and L1 cDNA is a recognized cGAS-STING/IFN-I trigger in AGS-like interferonopathies. It does not address A565T, mitochondria, NLRP3 or the core interferon-mitochondrial streams, and it is a germline/hESC model with indirect bearing on the family's cancer predisposition, fertility and pregnancy-related phenotypes.  
DOI: 10.4103/aja202636
